title: Indicator of an encoded index-language word
statement: For every predicate $p$ on bit strings and natural numbers, bit string $u$, and natural number $v$, the Boolean indicator of the language of encodings $	ext{pairEncode}(x,	ext{bits}(i))$ satisfying $p(x,i)$, evaluated at $	ext{pairEncode}(u,	ext{bits}(v))$, is true exactly when $p(u,v)$ holds and false otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a predicate on bit strings and natural numbers
